purpose: Teach: 伴奏/ダンサー/路面/アルファベット/質量/だらだら/燃費/ツーリング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、合唱コンクール、お前、伴奏係、決まったって聞いた!
lines.en: Riku — I heard you got the piano accompaniment gig for the chorus competition!
lines.style: Bright, excited energy right from the start. Quick rhythm matching her enthusiasm. A teasing warmth underneath — she's proud of him and letting it show. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化祭で、ダンサー、招聘するって話、知ってる?
lines.en: Yeah. Hey, do you know they're bringing in dancers for the culture festival?
lines.style: Hesitant opening — testing whether to share something. Curious and a little uncertain. Soft pace. Voice lifts slightly at the end like he's genuinely wondering if she knows.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の路面、最近、工事してたよね、デコボコだったよ。
lines.en: The road in front of the station — they've been doing construction lately, hasn't it been all torn up?
lines.style: Flat, disconnected tone. Like she's thinking out loud about something that has nothing to do with this conversation. Slower pace. A moment of drift.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の名前、アルファベット表記、お洒落でいいよな、桜。
lines.en: Your name in romaji is actually pretty cool, you know? Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered quietly. A small moment of sincerity breaking through his usual cool. Warm but careful — not overdone. Slight hesitation before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 物理、質量と重さの違い、難しいよね、テスト、出るかな。
lines.en: Physics is rough — the difference between mass and weight. You think it'll be on the test?
lines.style: Dry, almost joking frustration. Resigned to the difficulty but poking fun at it. Short phrases. A little roll of the eyes in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 休みの日、家でだらだら過ごすの、結構好きだぜ、俺。
lines.en: I actually kind of like just hanging around at home on days off, you know?
lines.style: Relaxed confession. Like he's admitting something small that matters. Slow, comfortable pace. A touch of defensiveness softened by genuine contentment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの新車、燃費、いいんだって、自慢してた、昨日。
lines.en: My dad was bragging yesterday about the fuel efficiency on his new car.
lines.style: Animated mockery of her father's pride. Light, almost conspiratorial — sharing the joke. Quick, bouncy rhythm. Warmth underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お兄さんと、ツーリング、行く約束、してるんだ、今度。
lines.en: I actually promised my older brother we'd go on a touring trip soon.
lines.style: Genuine anticipation breaking through. Slightly brighter than before. A small lift at 'promised' — real excitement finally showing. Still measured but warmer.
